param_injection._comment: One entry per runtime_params key — see CLAUDE.md 'Launch contract' rule 3. Records how a value actually reaches the code (via: cli | yaml | env | hardcoded | derived) and whether an external override survives (overridable). runtime_params must hold the EFFECTIVE-at-runtime value. For eval this guards the metric-shaping params — a --conf-threshold or --nms-iou the code ignores makes every threshold sweep return the same numbers.
